mapper.select: select s.*,d.name as doctor_name,d.fee,dp.name as dept_name from schedule s left join doctor d on s.doctor_id=d.id left join department dp on d.dept_id=dp.id where s.doctor_id=#{doctorId} and s.work_date>=curdate() order by s.work_date,s.time_slot
select s.*,d.name as doctor_name,d.fee,dp.name as dept_name from schedule s left join doctor d on s.doctor_id=d.id left join department dp on d.dept_id=dp.id where s.id=#{id}
select * from schedule where doctor_id=#{doctorId} and work_date=#{workDate} and time_slot=#{timeSlot}
mapper.update: update schedule set remain_count=remain_count-1 where id=#{id} and remain_count>0
update schedule set remain_count=remain_count+1 where id=#{id} and remain_count<total_count
